about: server-only email Campaign warnings: on_reply_ignored, email_gap_low, no_mailbox

warnings.rule: on_reply_ignored: A reply ends this Campaign because it has an email step; this reply route is not taken.
warnings.message: on_reply_ignored: A reply ends this Campaign because it has an email step; this reply route is not taken.
warnings.hint: Remove on_reply, or set it to end: in a Campaign with an email step a reply ends the Enrollment by settings.reply_scope.

warnings.rule: email_gap_low: 1 minute between two emails from one Mailbox reads as automation; 5 or more is safer
warnings.message: email_gap_low: 1 minute between two emails from one Mailbox reads as automation; 5 or more is safer
warnings.hint: Set schedule.min_email_gap_minutes to 5 or more, the default.

warnings.rule: no_mailbox: acc_x has no Mailbox that can send, so its Leads wait at their email steps; connect one, or choose a shared Mailbox
warnings.message: no_mailbox: acc_x has no Mailbox that can send, so its Leads wait at their email steps; connect one, or choose a shared Mailbox
warnings.hint: Connect a Mailbox for the Account, or add a shared Mailbox to the Campaign's shared_mailbox_ids.
